header.name: Merge Inventory
header.description:
Take some quantity from the source inventory and transfer it to the destination inventory.

If the source inventory is completely consumed, you may pass "true" into the "mergeAll" input to delete (deactivate) the source inventory after the merge. You may either pass in "true" for "mergeAll" OR a quantity for "mergeQty", but not both.

branches.name: Source and Destination Are The Same
Inventory Weight Unit Mismatch
branches.transform:
$state.context.(
  $exists(sourceInventory.netWeight.unitId) ? (
    $not(sourceInventory.netWeight.unitId = destinationInventory.netWeight.unitId)
    or
    $not(sourceInventory.grossWeight.unitId = destinationInventory.grossWeight.unitId) 
    or
    $not(sourceInventory.netWeight.unitId = sourceInventory.grossWeight.unitId) 
  ) : false
)

nodes.name: Merge Context Check Source Destination Mismatches

data.responseTransform:
$state.context.({
  "success": false,
  "severity": "error",
  "title": "Handling Unit Check Failed",
  "message": "Source and destination inventory belong to different handling units.",
  "data": {
    "Source Inventory": sourceInventory.serialNumber,
    "Destination Inventory": destinationInventory.serialNumber,

    "Source Handling Unit ID": sourceInventory.handlingUnitId,
    "Destination Handling Unit ID": destinationInventory.handlingUnitId,

    "context": input.debugMode ? $state.context,
    "payload": input.debugMode ? $$
  }
})

data.responseTransform:
$state.context.({
  "success": true,
  "severity": "success",
  "title": "Merge Successful",
  "message": "The specified quantity of inventory has been successfully merged from the source into the destination.",
  "data": {
    "Source Inventory Quantity": sourceInventory.($string(quantity.value) & " " & quantity.unit.code) & " -> " & newSourceInventory.($string(quantity.value) & " " & quantity.unit.code),
    "Source Inventory Net Weight": $exists(sourceInventory.netWeight.value) ? sourceInventory.($string(netWeight.value) & " " & netWeight.unit.code) & " -> " & newSourceInventory.($string(netWeight.value) & " " & netWeight.unit.code),
    "Source Inventory Gross Weight": $exists(sourceInventory.grossWeight.value) ? sourceInventory.($string(grossWeight.value) & " " & grossWeight.unit.code) & " -> " & newSourceInventory.($string(grossWeight.value) & " " & grossWeight.unit.code),
    
    "Destination Inventory Quantity": destinationInventory.($string(quantity.value) & " " & quantity.unit.code) & " -> " & newDestinationInventory.($string(quantity.value) & " " & quantity.unit.code),
    "Destination Inventory Net Weight": $exists(destinationInventory.netWeight.value) ? destinationInventory.($string(netWeight.value) & " " & netWeight.unit.code) & " -> " & newDestinationInventory.($string(netWeight.value) & " " & netWeight.unit.code),
    "Destination Inventory Gross Weight": $exists(destinationInventory.grossWeight.value) ? destinationInventory.($string(grossWeight.value) & " " & grossWeight.unit.code) & " -> " & newDestinationInventory.($string(grossWeight.value) & " " & grossWeight.unit.code),
    
    "context": input.debugMode ? $state.context,
    "payload": input.debugMode ? $$
  }
})

{
  "success": false,
  "severity": "error",
  "title": "Inventory Unit Type Mismatch",
  "message": "The unit type (usually Amount, Length, or Weight) between source and destination inventory quantities does not match. Make sure they are both measured in the same way.",
  "data": $state.context.{
    "Source Unit": sourceInventory.quantity.unit.name,
    "Source Unit Type": sourceInventory.quantity.unit.unitTypeId,
    "Destination Unit": destinationInventory.quantity.unit.name,
    "Destination Unit Type": destinationInventory.quantity.unit.unitTypeId,
    "context": input.debugMode ? $state.context,
    "payload": input.debugMode ? $$
  }
}

{
  "success": false,
  "severity": "error",
  "title": "Quantity Unit Type Mismatch",
  "message": "The unit type (usually Amount, Length, or Weight) between the selected inventory's quantity and the merge quantity does not match. Make sure to select a matching unit type.",
  "data": $state.context.{
    "Source Unit": sourceInventory.quantity.unit.name,
    "Source Unit Type": sourceInventory.quantity.unit.unitTypeId,
    "Destination Unit": destinationInventory.quantity.unit.name,
    "Destination Unit Type": destinationInventory.quantity.unit.unitTypeId,
    "context": input.debugMode ? $state.context,
    "payload": input.debugMode ? $$
  }
}
